name: Ruins of Constellas
summary: The Ruins of Constellas are the shattered remnants of an ancient night elf settlement in Felwood, nestled near the roots of Mount Hyjal. Today, the once-sacred grounds are overrun by the Jadefire satyrs, who have violently profaned the settlement's moonwell with demonic fel magic.

sections.title: A Defiled Sanctuary
sections.body: The classical stone arches and crumbling plazas of Constellas reveal that this was once an idyllic night elven community. During the Third War, the Burning Legion's march through Felwood shattered the haven, leaving it exposed to lingering demonic corruption. Now, the foul Jadefire satyrs hold dominion over the stones. Led by Xavathras, they actively tend to a defiled moonwell, transforming pure waters into a font of noxious fel power on behalf of their master, Lord Xavaric.

sections.title: The Struggle for Cleansing
sections.body: The defilement of Constellas weighs heavily on all who would heal Felwood. To those working to cleanse the forest, Xavathras and his Jadefire are among its foulest corrupters, and the satyrs fiercely guard their tents among the ruins and the tainted moonwell at their heart against any who come to end their work.

faq.q: What was Constellas before the corruption?
faq.answer: Constellas was an ancient night elf settlement near the base of Mount Hyjal. Its architecture and moonwell indicate it served as a serene grove dedicated to Elune and nature before the Burning Legion invaded the forest during the Third War.
The ruins are occupied by the Jadefire satyrs, led on-site by Xavathras. They cultivate demonic energies throughout the area under the overarching commands of Lord Xavaric.

faq.q: What happened to the moonwell in Constellas?
faq.answer: The moonwell was seized by the Jadefire satyrs and corrupted with fel magic. Instead of channeling the soothing blessings of Elune, it has been twisted into a toxic source of fel energy cultivated by Xavathras.
Xavaric is another cruel satyr of the Jadefire, and the one Xavathras serves. The corrupted moonwell at Constellas is cultivated on his behalf.

angles.text: The desecration of Constellas and its corrupted moonwell is an egregious affront to Elune, demanding that night elves drive out the Jadefire satyrs.
A once-sacred moonwell now tended by demons makes Constellas a stark reminder of the druidic vow to restore balance to Felwood.
